source.title: Lucy - Celestial Spirit Mage
source.name: Lucy
source.description: A Celestial Spirit Mage who can summon Celestial Spirits using Gate Keys to assist in battle.

skills.name: Celestial Spirit Summon

description.raw: Lucy calls out Aquarius, a Celestial Spirit, to assist her in battle. Aquarius has 120% of Lucy's max HP and 100% of Lucy's other stats. Upon entering battle, Aquarius immediately conjures a water swirl that strikes the 1-tile area with the most enemies, dealing 300% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to all enemies in the area. The affected enemies are knocked into the air and stunned for 2s. The water swirl attack repeats every 10s. Aquarius' normal attack deals 100% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage with a range of 10 tiles.

The affected enemies are knocked into the air and stunned for 2s.
The water swirl attack repeats every 10s.
Aquarius' normal attack deals 100% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage with a range of 10 tiles.

text: Increases the damage to Aquarius' water swirl to 325% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based).
Increases the damage to Aquarius' water swirl to 350% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Lucy calls out Aquarius, a Celestial Spirit, to assist her in battle. Aquarius inherits some of Lucy's stats. Upon entering battle, Aquarius immediately starts a water swirl attack that deals AoE damage, knocks enemies into the air, and stuns them. This water swirl attack repeats at regular intervals.

skills.name: Lucy Kick

description.raw: Lucy delivers a powerful kick to the enemy who has dealt the most cumulative damage, dealing 240% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage and stunning them for 2.5s. After the kick, she returns to her original tile. Lucy remains unaffected while using this skill.

After the kick, she returns to her original tile.
Lucy remains unaffected while using this skill.

skills.description_lite: Lucy kicks the enemy who has dealt the most cumulative damage, dealing damage and stunning them.

skills.name: Star Dress: Aquarius Form

description.raw: Lucy's Ultimate transforms her into Aquarius for the rest of the battle. While in this form, she conjures water swirls that strike the 1-tile area with the most enemies, dealing 300% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to all enemies in the area. The water swirl also knocks enemies into the air and stuns them for 2s. In Aquarius form, Lucy's attack range extends to 10 tiles.

skills.name: Water Barrier

description.raw: Aquarius, or Lucy in Aquarius form, can cast Water Barrier to grant a shield that blocks 450% (ATK-based) damage to the weakest ally, lasting 8s.

text: Increases the shielded ally's Ranged DEF by 50 while the shield is active.r

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: When Lucy reaches full Energy while Aquarius is on the battlefield, Aquarius' ATK SPD increases by 80.
